analytics.consent: Optional event transmission is disabled until explicit opt-in and is suppressed by Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track.
analytics.storage: Aggregate totals are keyed by dish, day and event. No reviewer identity, IP address or user identifier is written to the aggregate table.
analytics.contract_fix: The event endpoint now returns success only when at least one real Dish identity was inserted or incremented. An all-unknown dish payload returns 404.
analytics.production_persistence: Not tested because that would create an artificial production analytics count without a real consenting user action or authorised read-only database access.

sponsorship.current_state: No payment-based or sponsored ranking is implemented or enabled.
sponsorship.star_dish_scope: Reviewed owner/source star evidence can add a small evidence preference, but eligibility filtering runs first.
sponsorship.label_rule: Star or paid-slot evidence is not labelled Sponsored. A sponsored label remains reserved for a future explicit sponsored record.
sponsorship.future_gate: Any future sponsored candidate must pass the same dietary, budget, distance, requested-dish and verified-availability filters before ranking, and must be explicitly labelled.

blockers: Production analytics persistence needs either a real consented user event with its aggregate verified by an authorised read-only database query, or founder-authorised controlled test data.
A production sponsorship acceptance test cannot exist until sponsorship records and placement are intentionally implemented and approved.
